script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying every rung has someone looking down on it goes beyond the officials and superiors the verse describes.
The verse does not say that nobody is starting a revolution or that everyone is just being watched.
The next verse says the king profits from the fields, not that he is physically out in them.
The bottomless cookie jar comparison does not fit: an empty jar that someone keeps reaching into does not clearly illustrate having money without being satisfied.
The verse does not establish that nobody is glaring or that all those consuming the good things are eating.
Calling the Teacher's question a funny punchline makes the way Scripture is written the joke.
The verse says the worker sleeps sweetly, not that he snores.
The sad dessert joke makes light of the sorrow and sickness in the verse. It also mentions dessert without identifying it as cookies.
The explanation says the few days are part of why the Teacher calls satisfaction good and fitting. The verse does not state that reason.
The verse describes wealth hoarded to its owner's harm as the problem. Saying hoarding itself is the problem drops that qualification.
The passage does not say that counting is what the lover of money does.
The passage does not identify counting wealth as the money lover's habit.
